@america_vest They're saving it for the general.

A lot have people have apparently deleted their #MeToo  and Kavanaugh tweets, though. I guess they don't want to be on record as being against sexual assault?

@Out5p0ken @JoeBiden Your profile has #MeToo in it, so I assume you think we should believe women who come forward? Do you not extend that to Tara Reade as well?

Biden, the Dem leadership and the media are silent, and many are deleting their tweets about Kavanaugh. Are you willing to overlook that?

@TrumpTheTRAIT0R @Out5p0ken @JoeBiden Then you don't understand the concept of #MeToo and #BelieveWomen.

As for MAGA, you do realize that Trump hasn't said anything about it? Why is that, do you think? Tara Reade will get her hearing, but the Dems are making sure it happens during the general instead of the primary.

@HansMeyer360 @DJDynamicNC @markos Funny you should mention Kavanaugh.

#BelieveWomen #MeToo

@baburgeson @YoungDemocratUS @BoyGash @JoeBiden Funny you should mention Kavanaugh. Did you believe Ford? Probably. Do you believe Reade? Probably not, because if you did #BelieveWomen, you wouldn't shame people who refuse to vote for Biden.

#MeToo

@BroncoBaby10 I'm a European woman, and if I was asked which rapist I would vote for, I'd tell them to fuck off.

You're asking "will you vote for Biden or Trump?" 

I'm asking "will you demand that the Dem party removes Biden before the general?"

#BelieveWomen #MeToo

@politico If you have to grapple with it, you never cared about #MeToo. You never believed women, only the right kind.

I have no illusions about the Dem party. This was swept under the rug and they're still hiding it. I just wonder when Trump will change his nickname to Rapist Joe.
@Rudiethedog @politico Funny, you're doing exactly what Kavanaugh and his defenders did. I hope you never talked about #MeToo or #BelieveWomen, because you can't pick and choose.

@politico Man, reading all the comments from Democrats who used to support #MeToo...

Seeing them use the same arguments that have always been used against survivors, like "she changed her story!" "why didn't she come out earlier?" and "the timing is very convenient" is sickening.

@libbycwatson @akervik_leah Imagine watching #MeToo happen, and then coming out with her story. Imagine being ripped to pieces by the very people who screamed "Believe women!" at the top of their voice.

Those people are such hypocrites. I wonder if they still consider themselves to be good people?

@data_nerd @FlyThaiMMA @realDonaldTrump You should educated yourself on the trauma of sexual assault, the many psychological consequences it can have, and the stigmatization of sexual assault victims.

I guess #MeToo was no more than a pretty slogan for people like you.

@johnclavis @Kate_Kelly_Esq It's dishonest to say that Dems largely supported #MeToo? That Dems largely believed and supported Blazey-Ford against Kavanaugh?

I can't know their motivations, just their actions. They're treating Reade exactly like Republicans treated Dr. Ford, and with the same arguments.

@KayEllen48 @Kris_Sacrebleu What Daou's saying is true. When do YOU want the American people to hear about it? There is credible evidence, and this is a prime example of why #MeToo was needed. Seems like a lot of Dems only #BelieveWomen when it's convenient.

Oh, and stop pushing censorship.

@Changinglenses @politico Then you don't understand what #MeToo is. Most accusations are true, and the treatment the survivors get is the reason why the large majority of cases go unreported. In high profile cases, this is especially true.

Why do you not believe Tara when the evidence is on her side?

@AndrewFrisbie05 @ellen_guenther @thehill Not to mention #MeToo. It gave a lot of women the courage and public support to come forward.

Sadly, the Democrats who supported #MeToo are now removing the hashtag from their profiles, and defending Biden with the same lines Republicans used to protect Kavanaugh.

@tookanderson @WalkerBragman @nerdythor That DOES happen. Most survivors don't even go that far. Instead they keep it to themselves, or possibly tell someone they're close to.

What do you even think #MeToo and #BelieveWomen was about?

@la_leere @akervik_leah Reading hit-pieces on sexual assault survivors in "respected" media after #MeToo is sad.

Not surprising, but still sad.

@RadioFreeTom I'm sorry, are you under the impression that these protesters are Democrats, or that the protests are in any way connected to the Dems?

Biden has NO SAY in this. #BlackLivesMatter, and don't you dare try to co-opt their fight!
